text:
Evelyn: dropped a compact mock for the version timeline focusing on quick undo and clear canary chips. figma: https://figma.redwood/compact-undo
Marco: love the compact rows. Question: where does the "Undo" live? snackbar, inline action, or in history?
Evelyn: snackbar with an actionable "Undo" is preferred for quick fixes. also show a small 'Revert history' link in the toast for audit reference.
Tess: accessibility nit: snackbar needs aria-live=\"assertive\" when undo is available and the button needs an accessible name like "Undo restore to v42".
Ravi: backend note: we can support a 5-minute undo window if we keep the previous routing state for that time. will expose an API flag `quick_undo=true` in the restore call.
Marco: visual: canary chip should read "canary · 10%" and be focusable. when focused, show keyboard tooltip with exact allocation and an action hotkey (e.g., press Enter to open details).
Evelyn: microcopy for the restore modal: header "Restore deployment", body "Switch traffic and configuration to v42. Does not delete versions. In-flight requests may be affected.", primary "Restore now", secondary "Cancel". Small helper: "Technical action: rollback" in muted text.
Tess: prefer "Restore" for users. confirm that the aria-labels match the visible copy so screen reader users hear the same word.
Ravi: confirm API mapping: UI uses friendly copy; event payload will include {"action":"rollback","quick_undo":true}. We'll include mapping string in the audit details.
Marco: animation: show a short 8s countdown bar in the snackbar while undo is available. for reduced-motion users, replace with a numeric timer.
Evelyn: chips + diff: show tiny inline diff summary (one line) for quick scan, expand to full JSON in a modal. ensure diff badges (added/removed) have text labels, not color-only.
Tess: tooltip rules: role=\"tooltip\" and ensure it is dismissible via Escape and loses focus when tabbed away. add aria-describedby from chip to tooltip.
build-bot: build: rollout-compact-ui changed tokens and accessibility tweaks  build passed.
Ravi: action items: Marco to prototype keyboard tooltip, Tess to draft aria strings, Evelyn to update figma copy, I'll wire the quick_undo API flag and return details for audit.
Evelyn: thanks all  will iterate and post updated frames.
